```{r}
#| echo: false
f1 <- doodle_fun( ~ z, seed = 932)
slice_plot(f1(z-3) ~ z, domain(z=0:5)) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

i. Which of the following choices are closest to the *argmin* of the function displayed in the graph?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(choices = c(-6, 0.5, 3, 8), correct=3, id = "D10-sdo-argmin")`

ii. Which is closest to the *maximum* of the function?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(choices = c(-6, 0.5, 3, 8), correct=8, id = "D10-sdo-max")`

iii. Which is closest to the *argmax* of the function?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(choices = c(-6, 0.5, 3, 8), correct=0.5, id = "D10-sdo-argmax")`
:::
